mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a permitted clinical operation to exist with no care-team membership row linking the caller to the patient, violating the central access-control invariant of FR-004.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamGatingViolation { some op: Operation | (op.opKind = RecordsLookup) and op.opOutcome = Permitted and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.ctmClinician = op.opCaller and m.ctmPatient = op.opPatient) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a HospitalAdministrator to have a permitted operation on RecordsLookup or RecordsNotes, violating the role-segregation invariant in FR-005 and the permission matrix in F_PermissionMatrix.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AdminClinicalAccessViolation { some op: Operation | op.opCaller.role = HospitalAdministrator and op.opKind = RecordsLookup and op.opOutcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows an Operation to exist whose linked AuditEntry does not correctly record the caller or patient — or allows an AuditEntry to be shared by two Operations — violating the always-on, one-to-one audit invariant of FR-012 and FR-013.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditCorrespondenceViolation { some op: Operation | op.opAudit.aeAccessor != op.opCaller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a ClinicalNote to exist in the system without any corresponding add_note + permitted audit entry, breaking the append-only creation trail and the FR-011 invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyNotesViolation { some n: ClinicalNote | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.aeNoteRef = n and ae.aeAccessType = AddNoteAT and ae.aeOutcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows aeNoteRef to be set on a non-add_note or non-permitted audit entry, violating the structural CHECK constraint from data-model.md and FR-013.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditNoteIdRuleViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.aeAccessType = ReadAT and one ae.aeNoteRef }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a HospitalAdministrator to be recorded as the author of a ClinicalNote, violating the structural author_role CHECK in data-model.md and FR-005/FR-010.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoteAuthorRoleViolation { some n: ClinicalNote | n.noteAuthor.role = HospitalAdministrator }
